source_artifact.name: ULES00270 debug/review BOOT.BIN
source_artifact.note: Raw file offsets in this ELF are normally virtual address +0x100 for the mapped text/rodata region. Earlier exploratory physique xrefs that used raw file offsets as virtual addresses are superseded by this artifact.

relationship_to_age_evidence.note: Age is stored in the career progression record, not in the boxer physical halfword cluster described below.

persistent_boxer_physical_block.base: persistent boxer object; player instance is stored at profile+0x256C
persistent_boxer_physical_block.confidence: CONFIRMED field placement for height/weight; paired-field semantics partially unresolved

evidence: XDB->boxer mapper 0x0018A2C0 stores XDB boxer field 8 into boxer+0x6A.
Create-physique height selection writes the selected division-bounded integer-inch value to +0x6A.
Generated-boxer initialization writes a randomly chosen division-bounded height to +0x6A.
3D/runtime construction code at 0x002CB364 loads boxer+0x6A, converts it to float and divides by 72.0 before storing a body/model scale value.
XDB field 9 is independently proven as boxer weight.
Generated-boxer initialization derives +0x6C from division and height through 0x0018E1C8.

+0x6E.warning: Do not call this age. Persistent career age is progression record+0x09 from XDB field 13.

evidence: XDB->boxer mapper stores helper 0x00185374(field 11) into boxer+0x70.
Generated-boxer initialization writes the same newly generated height to +0x6A and +0x70.
Create-physique height toggle likewise updates +0x6A and +0x70 together.
Boxer generic field accessor exposes +0x70 as a distinct field.
+0x70.boundary: The evidence does not yet distinguish these interpretations. Reach is plausible but NOT promoted.

evidence: XDB->boxer mapper stores XDB field 12 into boxer+0x72.
Generated-boxer initialization derives boxer+0x6C, then copies that same value to +0x72.
Boxer generic field accessor exposes +0x72 as a distinct field.
+0x72.boundary: Natural/walking weight is attractive for Career Mode 2.0 but is NOT promoted without a distinct consumer proving it.

creation_height_ranges.confidence: CONFIRMED integer-inch ranges; ordering follows the game's six division cases
creation_height_ranges.note: These are the permitted/generated height ranges observed in create/generated-boxer code. This artifact does not relabel each pair with a division name unless the switch ordering is independently tied to the already-proven division enum.

map.field 13: NOT this boxer cluster: separate age accessor path feeds progression record+0x09

behavior: Writes height to both boxer+0x6A and boxer+0x70.
generated_boxer_initialization.implication: The game intentionally models two height-linked and two weight-linked fields, initialized identically for generated boxers.

behavior: Normally returns the raw signed value.
When fight-session byte +0x1921 is nonzero and the raw value is at least 63, returns approximately five-eighths of the original value.
field_11_transform.boundary: The conditional conversion is a reason NOT to rename field 11/+0x70 as reach until the fight-session flag and downstream consumer are understood.

mutation_audit.confidence: CONFIRMED for direct halfword stores in the debug ELF; indirect generic setters can still mutate the fields

+0x6A: career/profile initialization/reset contexts that are not all boxer-object writes

mutation_audit.conclusion: No dedicated annual physical-growth writer has been identified for the persistent boxer body fields. Existing AI annual aging increments progression age, but that by itself does not mutate height/weight.

design_opportunity: Career Mode 2.0 can implement adolescent physical growth by adding a yearly growth writer above these existing persistent physical fields.
If +0x70/+0x72 are later proven as reach/natural weight, they provide ideal built-in targets for the user's reach and natural-weight growth model.
Until then, new growth projection/potential data must remain separate rather than overwriting unresolved retail fields.
next_static_step: Trace non-UI consumers of boxer+0x70 and boxer+0x72 to determine their exact semantics.
Audit all player-age advancement paths; the known population aging loop skips the player, so determine whether a separate player birthday path exists.
Trace weight-class reassignment after boxer-weight changes.
Only after those boundaries are proven should Career Mode 2.0 define yearly height/reach/weight growth writes.
